snippet.title: Time Takers | Steam Playtest #2, November 12 to 15 (UTC)
snippet.description:
Get ready to take time and survive another action-packed playtest!

📅 TEST SCHEDULE
UTC: November 12, 23:00 to November 15, 23:00
PST: November 12, 15:00 to November 15, 15:00
CET: November 13, 00:00 to November 16, 00:00
KST: November 13, 08:00 to November 16, 08:00

HOW TO JOIN
Request access on the Steam store page for guaranteed access and jump in as soon as it goes live. 

Participated in the previous playtest? You already have access, so there's no need to request again! 

Request access here 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3596040/Time_Takers/  

🎁 WHAT ELSE?
Daily login rewards are available for all three days. Join Discord to see the rewards 👉 https://discord.gg/timetakers

Discord: https://discord.gg/timetakers
Website: https://timetakers.plaync.com/

See you in the playtest!

#timetakers #playtest
